scope: Native P1 Oseen block linear backend and bounded full nonlinear integration; no product qualification

environment.compiler:
Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.3.34.2)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin27.0.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin

method.velocityInverse: existing SparseSystem2D ILU0; nonsymmetric entries unchanged; IC0 symmetric-part and Jacobi controls retained
method.pressureInverse: negative viscosity times diagonal cell-mass inverse; closed last-cell gauge additionally uses rank-one mean-free inverse; outlet retains all cell pressures with absolute pressure level
method.viscosityMeaning: positive constant kinematic viscosity; pressure mass is a viscous Schur approximation only, not exact Oseen Schur or Reynolds-robust preconditioning
method.krylov: existing right-preconditioned GMRES, 60 directions per subspace, .1 work target, at most 50 outer restarts, original K/b and true unpreconditioned residual

researchControls.normalization: existing U=L=1 controls, pressure U^2; explicit research stopping controls, not physical accuracy gates

method.stateComparison: native geometry and state reader, exact polynomial quadrature for P1 velocity/pressure RMS; one global pressure shift only in separately labeled closed-domain metric; outlet absolute pressure is primary
method.driver: standard-library orchestration for native backend; optional NumPy dense reference capped at 2175 unknowns, no independent PDE assembly

negativeControls.label: one-linear-restart
negativeControls.failure: linear solve exited 2; candidate was not recovered or accepted

negativeControls.label: one-nonlinear-iteration
negativeControls.failure: nonlinear iteration budget exhausted; no final acceptance

limitations: Only 111/144 unknown frozen matrices and 511/576 unknown full nonlinear systems; original Re20 obstacle, larger meshes, memory and sparse-LU full-cost comparison not run here.
Uniform outlet control is obstacle-free, not a cylinder benchmark, despite the inherited problem keyword cylinder.
Natural symmetric-stress outlet differs from old product boundary semantics; no claim of repairing old spurious branch.
Pressure mass approximation may be inadequate for small viscosity, inertia or mesh refinement; original K remains unchanged and failures explicit.
P1 cell field comparison is not P2 potential velocity or RT1 transported velocity accuracy. Native checks report these separately.
Every successful linear iterate still needs original full nonlinear residual and state-change checks. Initial zero state and lastCompletedIterate are not physical checkpoints or accepted solutions.
No production/default/quality threshold changes; no full CTest/frontend/App/platform qualification in this research-only change.
Bounded NumPy reference repeats dense factorizations for residual correction; its time must not be used as a sparse-LU speedup benchmark.

archive.verifiedBy: Every regular member read and checked against exact bytes and SHA256; manifest itself read back and compared.
